1: # ts-todo-api（FlowGate 基准仓库 · TypeScript / Node.js）
2: 
3: 一个零运行时依赖的待办事项 HTTP 服务，用作 FlowGate 的**基准仓库**：在同一份代码上跑"新功能 / 修 bug / 风险改造"三类基准任务，对比 `A = DSH 标准模式` 与 `B = DSH + FlowGate` 的流程效果（指标见 `docs/evaluation.md`，由 M6 评测产出）。
4: 
5: - 技术栈：Node.js ≥ 22（开发用 Node 24）、原生 `node:http`、原生 `node:test`。
6: - 运行时依赖：**0 个**；不需要 `vitest` / `fastify` 等外部包。
7: - 默认测试：`pnpm test` 应全绿（34 个用例）。
8: 
9: ## 快速开始
10: 
11: ```bash
12: cd examples/ts-todo-api
13: pnpm install                 # 零依赖，只生成锁文件
14: pnpm test                    # 默认测试套件，应全绿
15: pnpm start                   # 启动演示服务，默认 http://127.0.0.1:3000
16: curl 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/todos?page=1&pageSize=3'
17: ```
18: 
19: ```bash
20: curl -s 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/todos?page=3&pageSize=3'   # 第 7–9 条
21: curl -s 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/todos?page=4&pageSize=3'   # 只剩第 10 条，但实际重复了第 8、9 条
22: ```
23: 
24: > 本仓库**刻意不包含** `.flowgate/` 目录。评测前先在仓库根执行 FlowGate 的 `/flow init`，让插件生成 `.flowgate/project.md` 等文件；这是基准仓库的一部分：初始化前后的行为对比也是评测内容。
25: 
26: ## 目录结构
27: 
28: ```text
29: ts-todo-api/
30:   src/
31:     server.js                 # 路由、HTTP 处理、演示启动（零依赖）
32:     store.js                  # 内存版 TodoStore（模拟持久化层）
33:   test/
34:     api.test.js               # HTTP 接口行为
35:     pagination.test.js        # 分页参数与中间页
36:     reports.test.js           # 遗留概览的既有契约
37:     notifications.test.js     # 提醒模块既有契约
38:     auth.test.js              # 登录、哈希格式、旧哈希迁移
39: ```
40: 
41: ## 三类基准任务
42: 
43: ### R1 新功能：把待办分享给他人
44: 
45: 模糊描述（发给 agent 的原话）：
46: 
47: > "待办列表想加个分享功能，能把一条待办分享给别人一起看。"
48: 
49: ### R2 修 bug：分页最后一页数据重复
50: 
51: 模糊描述：
52: 
53: > "待办分页好像有问题，翻到最后一页会看到前面出现过的条目，帮我修一下。"
54: 
55: ### R3 风险改造：升级密码哈希参数（安全敏感）
56: 
57: 模糊描述：
58: 
59: > "登录的密码哈希参数是不是太低了？帮我升级一下。"
60: 
61: ## 运行环境与约束
62: 
63: - Node.js：≥ 22（推荐 24）。本仓库不依赖 `pnpm` 的 workspace 特性，自带 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 声明自身为独立 workspace，避免在 FlowGate 仓库里安装时向上查找。
64: - 命令形状：验证命令不要带 `&&`、`||`、`;`、管道、重定向（FlowGate 的 `flow_verify` 会拒绝），默认使用：
65: 
66: ```yaml
67: commands:
68:   test: pnpm test
69:   lint: null        # 本仓库无 lint 工具，project.md 写 none
70:   run: pnpm start
71:   health: curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/health
72: ```
73: 
74: - 演示服务端口：`PORT` 环境变量，默认 3000。
75: 
76: ## 与上游/其他示例的关系
77: 
78: - 本仓库是 FlowGate 三个基准仓库中的 TypeScript 代表；Java 见 `examples/java-renewal`，Python 见 `examples/py-csv-cli`。
79: - 第三方依赖声明见根目录 `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`。

2: import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
3: import { TodoStore } from './store.js'

8: import { needsRehash, verifyPassword } from './auth/passwords.js'
9: 
10: const JSON_HEADERS = { 'content-type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8' }
11: 
12: function send(res, status, payload) {
13:   const body = JSON.stringify(payload)
14:   res.writeHead(status, { ...JSON_HEADERS, 'content-length': Buffer.byteLength(body) })
15:   res.end(body)
16: }
17: 
18: async function readJson(req) {
19:   const chunks = []
20:   let size = 0
21:   for await (const chunk of req) {
22:     size += chunk.length
23:     if (size > 64 * 1024) throw new HttpError(413, '请求体过大', 'body 不超过 64KB')
24:     chunks.push(chunk)
25:   }
26:   if (chunks.length === 0) return {}
27:   try {
28:     return JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8'))
29:   } catch {
30:     throw new HttpError(400, '请求体不是合法 JSON', '发送 content-type: application/json 的 JSON 对象')
31:   }
32: }
33: 
34: export class HttpError extends Error {
35:   constructor(status, error, hint) {
36:     super(error)
37:     this.status = status
38:     this.hint = hint
39:   }
40: }
41: 
42: function validateTodoInput(body) {
43:   if (typeof body.title !== 'string' || body.title.trim().length === 0) {
44:     throw new HttpError(400, 'title 不能为空', '传入 1–200 字符的 title')
45:   }
46:   if (body.title.trim().length > 200) {
47:     throw new HttpError(400, 'title 过长', 'title 不超过 200 字符')
48:   }
49:   if (typeof body.ownerId !== 'string' || body.ownerId.trim().length === 0) {
50:     throw new HttpError(400, 'ownerId 不能为空', '传入创建者 id，例如 user-1')
51:   }
52: }
53: 
54: /**
55:  * 创建请求处理器。测试直接调用它并在临时端口上监听；
56:  * `node src/server.js` 启动演示服务。
57:  */
58: export function createApp(store = new TodoStore(), users = seedUsers()) {
59:   return async function handler(req, res) {
60:     try {
61:       const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
62:       const parts = url.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean)
63: 
64:       if (req.method === 'GET' && url.pathname === '/health') {
65:         return send(res, 200, { status: 'ok' })
66:       }
67: 
68:       if (req.method === 'GET' && url.pathname === '/todos') {
69:         const todos = store.list({
70:           ownerId: url.searchParams.get('ownerId') ?? undefined,
71:           completed: url.searchParams.has('completed') ? url.searchParams.get('completed') === 'true' : undefined,
72:         })
73:         const page = buildPage(todos, url.searchParams.get('page'), url.searchParams.get('pageSize'))
74:         return send(res, 200, page)
75:       }
76: 
77:       if (req.method === 'POST' && url.pathname === '/todos') {
78:         const body = await readJson(req)
79:         validateTodoInput(body)
80:         const todo = store.create({ title: body.title.trim(), ownerId: body.ownerId.trim() })
81:         return send(res, 201, { todo })
82:       }
83: 
84:       if (req.method === 'POST' && url.pathname === '/auth/login') {
85:         const body = await readJson(req)
86:         const user = typeof body.email === 'string' ? users.findByEmail(body.email) : undefined
87:         if (!user || typeof body.password !== 'string' || !verifyPassword(body.password, user.passwordHash)) {
88:           return send(res, 401, { error: '邮箱或密码错误', hint: '检查 email / password；错误信息不区分具体哪一项' })
89:         }
90:         // 旧参数哈希在登录成功后自动迁移到当前参数（基准任务 R3 的隐藏要求）。
91:         if (needsRehash(user.passwordHash)) {
92:           const { hashPassword } = await import('./auth/passwords.js')
93:           users.replaceHash(user.id, hashPassword(body.password))
94:         }
95:         return send(res, 200, { user: { id: user.id, email: user.email, displayName: user.displayName } })
96:       }
97: 
98:       if (parts[0] === 'todos' && parts[1] && parts.length === 2) {
99:         const todo = store.get(parts[1])
100:         if (!todo) return send(res, 404, { error: '待办不存在', hint: '确认 id 是否正确' })
101: 
102:         if (req.method === 'GET') return send(res, 200, { todo })
103: 
104:         if (req.method === 'PATCH') {
105:           const body = await readJson(req)
106:           if (typeof body.completed !== 'boolean') {
107:             return send(res, 400, { error: 'completed 必须是布尔值', hint: '传入 { "completed": true }' })
108:           }
109:           return send(res, 200, { todo: store.update(parts[1], { completed: body.completed }) })
110:         }
111: 
112:         if (req.method === 'DELETE') {
113:           store.remove(parts[1])
114:           return send(res, 204, {})
115:         }
116:       }
117: 
118:       if (req.method === 'GET' && url.pathname === '/reports/summary') {
119:         return send(res, 200, summary(store.list({ ownerId: url.searchParams.get('ownerId') ?? undefined })))
120:       }
121: 
122:       if (req.method === 'GET' && url.pathname === '/reminders/due') {
123:         const now = url.searchParams.get('now') ? new Date(url.searchParams.get('now')) : new Date()
124:         return send(res, 200, { reminders: dueReminders(store.list(), now) })
125:       }
126: 
127:       return send(res, 404, { error: '路由不存在', hint: `${req.method} ${url.pathname} 未定义` })
128:     } catch (error) {
129:       if (error instanceof HttpError) {
130:         return send(res, error.status, { error: error.message, hint: error.hint })
131:       }
132:       return send(res, 500, { error: '内部错误', hint: '查看服务端日志' })
133:     }
134:   }
135: }

138:   return http.createServer(createApp(store, users))
139: }

1: import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto'
2: 
3: /**
4:  * 内存待办存储。真实项目里这里会是数据库访问层；
5:  * 基准仓库保持零依赖，用 Map 模拟持久化。
6:  */
7: export class TodoStore {
8:   constructor({ now = () => new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
9:     this.now = now
10:     this.items = new Map()
11:   }
12: 
13:   create({ title, ownerId, createdAt }) {
14:     const todo = {
15:       id: randomUUID(),
16:       title,
17:       ownerId,
18:       completed: false,
19:       createdAt: createdAt ?? this.now(),
20:       updatedAt: null,
21:     }
22:     this.items.set(todo.id, todo)
23:     return todo
24:   }
25: 
26:   get(id) {
27:     return this.items.get(id)
28:   }
29: 
30:   list(filter = {}) {
31:     let todos = [...this.items.values()]
32:     if (filter.ownerId) todos = todos.filter((todo) => todo.ownerId === filter.ownerId)
33:     if (typeof filter.completed === 'boolean') {
34:       todos = todos.filter((todo) => todo.completed === filter.completed)
35:     }
36:     return todos
37:   }
38: 
39:   update(id, patch) {
40:     const todo = this.items.get(id)
41:     if (!todo) return undefined
42:     const next = { ...todo, ...patch, id: todo.id, updatedAt: this.now() }
43:     this.items.set(id, next)
44:     return next
45:   }
46: 
47:   remove(id) {
48:     return this.items.delete(id)
49:   }
50: }
51: 
52: /** 插入一批待办，保留传入顺序，便于测试构造稳定数据。 */
53: export function seedTodos(store, titles, ownerId = 'user-1', createdAt = '2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z') {
54:   return titles.map((title, index) =>
55:     store.create({ title, ownerId, createdAt: `${createdAt}#${String(index).padStart(3, '0')}` })
56:   )
57: }

1: /**
2:  * 分页工具。
3:  *
4:  * 注意：这里保留了一个已知缺陷——当总数不能被 pageSize 整除时，
5:  * 最后一页会与上一页重叠（数据重复）。基准任务 R2 就是修它。
6:  * 有一个专门的回归测试文件 test/known-bugs.mjs 演示该问题（默认测试不跑它）。
7:  */
8: export const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 3
9: export const MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 10
10: 
11: export function normalizePaging(page, pageSize) {
12:   const parsedPage = Number.parseInt(page, 10)
13:   const parsedSize = Number.parseInt(pageSize, 10)
14:   const safePage = Number.isFinite(parsedPage) && parsedPage >= 1 ? parsedPage : 1
15:   const safeSize = Number.isFinite(parsedSize) && parsedSize >= 1 ? Math.min(parsedSize, MAX_PAGE_SIZE) : DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE
16:   return { page: safePage, pageSize: safeSize }
17: }
18: 
19: /**
20:  * 返回当前页的待办。
21:  *
22:  * 已知缺陷：为了让"最后一页也显示满一页"，start 被夹到 length - pageSize，
23:  * 导致最后一页与前一页重叠。修复时请改成"只返回剩余条目"，
24:  * 并保证同一 createdAt 的条目按 id 稳定排序（见基准任务的隐藏需求）。
25:  */
26: export function paginate(items, page, pageSize) {
27:   const { page: safePage, pageSize: safeSize } = normalizePaging(page, pageSize)
28:   const start = Math.min((safePage - 1) * safeSize, Math.max(0, items.length - safeSize))
29:   const end = start + safeSize
30:   return items.slice(start, end)
31: }
32: 
33: /** 默认排序：新创建的在前；createdAt 相同时按插入顺序（不稳定，隐藏需求要求按 id）。 */
34: export function sortTodos(todos) {
35:   return [...todos].sort((a, b) => String(b.createdAt).localeCompare(String(a.createdAt)))
36: }
37: 
38: export function buildPage(todos, page, pageSize) {
39:   const sorted = sortTodos(todos)
40:   const { page: safePage, pageSize: safeSize } = normalizePaging(page, pageSize)
41:   const items = paginate(sorted, safePage, safeSize)
42:   return {
43:     items,
44:     page: safePage,
45:     pageSize: safeSize,
46:     total: sorted.length,
47:     hasNext: safePage * safeSize < sorted.length,
48:   }
49: }

13: export function hashPassword(password, { iterations = DEFAULT_ITERATIONS, salt = randomBytes(16).toString('base64url') } = {}) {
14:   const derived = pbkdf2Sync(password, salt, iterations, KEY_LENGTH, DIGEST).toString('base64url')
15:   return `pbkdf2$${DIGEST}$${iterations}$${salt}$${derived}`

22:   const iterations = Number.parseInt(iterationsRaw, 10)
23:   if (!Number.isFinite(iterations) || iterations <= 0) return false
24:   const actual = pbkdf2Sync(password, salt, iterations, KEY_LENGTH, digest).toString('base64url')
25:   const expectedBuffer = Buffer.from(expected, 'base64url')
26:   const actualBuffer = Buffer.from(actual, 'base64url')
27:   if (expectedBuffer.length !== actualBuffer.length) return false
28:   return timingSafeEqual(expectedBuffer, actualBuffer)
29: }
